title: Market Data Replay
summary: Bounded ITCH-subset decoding and MoldUDP64 replay with sequence checks, overlapping retransmissions, and atomic packet recovery.
evidence: Independent book reference, sanitizer checks, and allocation-failure rollback evidence.
limitation: No live feed, PCAP parser or retransmission requester; checksum is not authentication.
decisions: Keep binary contracts and failure behavior reviewable.
Arbitrary full feeds with unsupported types fail closed.
Retain original map nodes until packet commit and restore them without allocation after failure.
Per-packet bookkeeping and active-locate scans still cost time.
Independent Python reference and frozen captures
Compare complete final orders and identities across implementations.
Synthetic captures do not establish live multicast correctness.
